items_missed: Never asked 'How are you today?' after getting the customer's name.

Did not proactively ask an open-ended stressors question ('Is there anything you're particularly worried about with this move?') — customer volunteered concern about her dining table getting damaged, but the rep never asked directly.
Never mentioned the No Worries Damage Coverage (up to $2,000 protection) despite the customer explicitly worrying about damage to her furniture.
Never mentioned Meet Your Mover (photo + info sent before the move).
Discussed the arrival window ('between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM') but never framed it as the On-Time Guarantee or mentioned the discounting-if-missed policy.
Did not state that the clock starts on-site when the contract opens.
No sense-check ('Does that make sense?') after explaining the clock or pricing.
Never explicitly stated that no deposit is required to book.
No comparison of No Worries coverage vs. the 60 cents/lb baseline insurance.
top_strength: Danah patiently reworked the generic online quote into an accurate, scaled-down estimate for the customer's actual six-piece storage move rather than pricing the full unit, and proactively reassured her about the movers' training when she raised concerns about her furniture.
coaching_note: Danah skipped all three core differentiators (No Worries Damage Coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) and never said 'no deposit required' — build these into every pricing walkthrough, especially here where the customer explicitly said she didn't want her dining table damaged.
phone_presence_notes: Frequent verbal affirmations ('Of course, of course', 'Yeah, of course') and direct reassurance about the movers' care with her furniture kept the customer comfortable, and the call closed on a warm, appreciative note from both sides.
